comparison: One presented 3.75-second 48 kHz stereo file per assessment. Reuse all 256 exact source WAVs from the held short stereo AAC study, with the 160 kb/s AAC readings as frozen comparison. Test 160 kb/s constant-bitrate 20 ms FFmpeg libopus Ogg encodes from the same exact WAV parents. No weights, earlier recording or thresholds changed. The 32 source groups and their known AAC outcomes have prior project exposure. This is an encoding qualification on previously isolated source groups with no fit on Opus.
proof: Require a single valid stereo stream, contiguous native Ogg pages and checksum, OpusHead with 312 leading samples discarded, 188 constant 400-byte packets of 20 ms, exact final granule and end trim, and an independently inspected decoded frame clock. Require exactly 180000 contiguous native stereo samples beginning at the zero-origin playback position. Keep positions in that native clock.
scope: Compare the unchanged lower-band stereo repeat check on 32 staged copies at 10 dB and 32 at 18 dB louder speech. Preserve all 192 ordinary controls, including a foreground-only repeat, changed background, different foreground direction and channels carrying identical sound. Match both proposed spans to the annotated pair at 0.50 intersection over union on each occurrence. Retain wrong locations and unassessed deliveries separately.
gate: Keep the candidate out of serving unless all clocks verify, at least 85 percent of the AAC useful locations remain, loss is no more than three useful locations at either level, the Opus cue adds no more than two control highlights across at most two source groups, and at least one useful case in 10 dB and 18 dB appears across each of two rooms in total. Only this explicit profile may qualify. The finding measures repeated sound and contributes zero AI-origin weight.
disclosure: Shared source material and mix schedules measure carrier transfer. The conditions are controlled environmental copies under speech. Counts are not deepfake detection rates or support for arbitrary voice messages. Source audio stays local. Save exact source and delivery SHA-256, clock and selected intervals for independent recount.
